The workshop

From our Riyadh workshop to your project

Al-Haddadah fabricates and installs ironwork and aluminum for homes, villas, shops and commercial buildings in Riyadh. Each job starts with a site survey and a conversation about materials, design and finish.

Founded in Riyadh to serve residential and commercial projects, the business continues to develop its equipment and fabrication methods in line with Saudi Vision 2030. Its vision is to lead in aluminum work, with a focus on quality that customers can see in the finished installation.
